title: Next-Work Batch Entry
description: One newline-delimited entry in .agents/rpi/next-work.jsonl (schema_version 1.4, docs/contracts/next-work.schema.md). One entry per producer event, usually one /post-mortem run. Entry-level lifecycle fields are aggregates; item lifecycle inside items[] is authoritative. additionalProperties is true: readers MUST tolerate unknown fields for forward compatibility.

source_epic.description: ID or slug of the source epic or session.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the entry was written.

items.description: Harvested follow-up work; may be empty when a post-mortem finds nothing actionable.

consumed.description: Aggregate entry status; true only when every child item is consumed.

consumed_note.description: Optional batch-level free-text summary of the consumption outcome across items (e.g. an operator's '[0] landed X; [2] deferred Y'). Per-item consumed_note in items[] is the first-class per-item form; this aggregate stays honored for back-compat reads.

consumed_ref.description: Optional batch-level machine anchor (bead ID or commit SHA) for the aggregate consumption outcome.
